t: What he said when something bore down on him
a: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
p: Lā ilāha illā-Llāhu-l-ʿalīmu-l-ḥalīm. Lā ilāha illā-Llāhu rabbu-l-ʿarshi-l-ʿaẓīm. Lā ilāha illā-Llāhu rabbu-s-samāwāti wa rabbu-l-arḍi rabbu-l-ʿarshi-l-karīm
m: There is no god but Allah, the Knowing, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the noble Throne.
